no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Company has undergone a strategic pivot away from pharmaceutical operations. Renamed Stablecoin Development Corp, the entity has adopted a digital-asset treasury strategy focused on acquiring and holding the SKY token (Sky Protocol) and stablecoins (USDS). No active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 clinical trials. All historical NovaBay-sponsored ClinicalTrials.gov records (n=7) are completed or unknown status.
